actual.scope: All1184 distinct normalized cycles receive the universal bounds, regardless of order. Fifty nontrivial cycles with L>=q and increasing normalized images receive the separate weighted and gap diagnostics. Scaling copies and all eleven raw fixtures remain explicit source controls.

single_defect_cancellation.scope: Gap oddpart removes only powers of2 from the positive difference. Gap/pair-gcd instead divides by the rational gcd of the two mantissas. The circular statistic includes the final gap to2L. These conventions are distinct.

clock: Positive raw odd-only cycles, no absorber. The explicitly invalid affine control is isolated and rejected.

domain.construction: Canonical lower mechanical c; h0=0; all 0<=h_i<=6 with a_i=c_i+h_i-h_(i+1)>=1, cyclic h_m=h0. All m<=11 and ceil(m log2 3)<=A<2m with gcd1; nearest-upper totals additionally at m13,17.

height_bound_candidate.statement: B<=q-1 on geometrically consistent ordered cycles
height_bound_candidate.status: finite diagnostic only; no theorem inferred

profiles.scope: All profiles produce legal positive primitive odd cycles, and all receive the universal prefix/packing checks. The prescribed height labels may fail geometric consistency or order; these failure classes are retained. Full rows including all numerator states enter the digest. No conclusion about untested periods, heights or arbitrary q1 words is inferred.

relaxed_affine_control.scope: A periodic affine control, not a raw odd-only cycle. It has an even state, a zero valuation and a final division that is not exact valuation. Ordered weighted equations alone would admit it; the strict declared domain rejects it.

scope: The packing/minimum denominator law is universal and is not claimed as order-specific progress or novel. Height/order profile failures and gap counterexamples expose missing hypotheses. Every success of B<=q-1 is finite evidence only; no unrestricted word or cycle conclusion follows.
status: Exact finite discrimination and universal-bound checks; circular-order q1 exclusion and the speculative height bound remain unproved.
